<!-- omgithub:readme:end -->

## Little Acre

A cozy, touch-friendly pocket farm built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Tend a 3×3 garden, rotate through four seasons, plant seasonal crops, water them, harvest for coins and seeds, and let the garden save automatically in your browser.

### Play

Open `index.html` in a browser, or serve this folder with any static web server. Choose a seed, tap an empty bed to plant, switch to **Water**, and tend it before **End the day**. Once a crop is ripe, choose **Harvest** to collect its reward. Tap a seed packet with no stock to buy more. Progress is saved locally on your device.

+
+## Little Acre
+
+A cozy, touch-friendly pocket farm built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Tend a 3×3 garden, rotate through four seasons, plant seasonal crops, water them, harvest for coins and seeds, and let the garden save automatically in your browser.
+
+### Play
+
+Open `index.html` in a browser, or serve this folder with any static web server. Choose a seed, tap an empty bed to plant, switch to **Water**, and tend it before **End the day**. Once a crop is ripe, choose **Harvest** to collect its reward. Tap a seed packet with no stock to buy more. Progress is saved locally on your device.
+

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, mobile-friendly “2D Pocket Stardew Valley” with a 3×3 farm and seasons.

## Requirements
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support phone/tablet layouts and touch controls.
- User requested screenshots for checks as small JPEGs (≤1280px wide).

## Decisions
- Implemented a standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with emoji crops, four rotating seasons, and browser-local save data.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a responsive 3×3 farm game with plant, water, harvest, clear-bed, buy-seeds, end-day, weather, crop growth, seasonal rotation, and localStorage persistence.
- Added play instructions to `README.md`.
- Verified JavaScript syntax and tested planting, watering, day progression, and harvest in browser; confirmed no browser console errors after adding the favicon.
- Captured a latest viewport screenshot at `screenshots/current.jpg` (390px viewport).

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. If further verification is needed, inspect `screenshots/current.jpg` or continue testing the game in the browser.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game structure and interface.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and seasonal scene styles.
- `game.js`: Game logic, crop growth, seasons, and persistence.
- `README.md`: Brief game instructions.
- `screenshots/current.jpg`: Latest small JPEG browser screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local browser test was performed; test data was removed from localStorage and the page reloaded afterward.

content.text:
Built **Little Acre**, a touch-friendly 3×3 pocket farm with four rotating seasons, seasonal crops, planting, watering, harvesting, seed purchases, weather, and automatic browser saves.

To play, open `index.html` or serve the project with a static web server. The game instructions are in `README.md`. I checked the JavaScript syntax and tested the main planting-to-harvest flow in a browser; the latest mobile screenshot is `screenshots/current.jpg`.

Assumption: each season lasts seven in-game days. Garden progress is saved locally in the browser.
